SR-23 & SR-21 ACADEMIC REGULATIONS - SRINIET
1. Semester: 21 weeks, 90 working days, 8W instruction +1W Mid+8W instruction+1W Mid+1W prep+2W exams
2. Attendance: 75% minimum required. Below 65% detained. 65-75% condonation allowed with medical certificate.
3. Evaluation: Theory 30 internal (15+15 mid average) +70 external. Lab 30+70.
4. Grading: O-10, A+ -9, A-8, B+-7, B-6, C-5, F-0
5. Promotion: II to III year need 50% credits of I year. III to IV need all I year +50% II year credits.
6. Regist

IV need all I year +50% II year credits.
6. Registration compulsory each semester, clear dues, no in-absentia.
7. Duration: 4 years B.Tech, max 8 years.
8. Honors: CGPA>8 can take 20 extra credits for Honors/Minor degree.
9. Malpractice rules as per JNTUK strict.
10. Supplementary exams after semester, revaluation allowed.

R23 SYLLABUS - SRINIET CSE/AIML
Engineering Workshop: Wood joints, Sheet metal tray funnel, Fitting V-fit dovetail, Electrical wiring parallel series two-way godown, Foundry, Welding lap butt.
C Programming:
Unit1: Computer basics ALU memory, Algorithm flowchart, Data types
Unit2: Control - if else switch, loops for while do-while break continue
Unit3: Arrays 1D 2D, Strings
Unit4: Pointers address arithmetic, Structures Unions
Unit5: Functions declaration call, Scope lifetime, File handling
